name: autoresearch
description: Autonomous experiment loop for Claude Code: run, measure, keep or discard. A port of pi-autoresearch.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at context percent
compactAtPercent.description: Compact the conversation between iterations once the context window is at least this full (0 turns it off).

questionWaitMinutes.title: Wait for a reply to a question (minutes)
questionWaitMinutes.description: When a turn in the loop ends by asking you something, wait this many minutes for your reply before the loop carries on without it (0 carries on at once, as upstream).
